_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description (most of these have none set). Setting them on GitHub too is worth doing - it helps anyone browsing your repo list.

projects.description: Voltix - a real-time home energy intelligence platform that fuses solar inverter telemetry, grid-side smart meter data, and on-server machine learning into one glanceable dashboard with anomaly detection and an intelligent meter advisor.
A smart construction expense management system that tracks project costs, materials, labour, and budgets in real time - financial control and efficient project execution in a single dashboard.
A React + Vite portfolio builder that lets anyone design, customize, preview, and export a deploy-ready personal portfolio website - no code required.
Router Kawaii - an Electron desktop control centre for managing multiple home network routers through one unified interface.
